requiredUserExports: GATS standard export: five crop products, World and all partners, monthly quantities for complete US 2024/25 marketing years; retain commodity codes, conversion basis, units, revisions and re-export definition. Wheat June-May, corn/soy September-August, rice/cotton August-July must be confirmed in export metadata. Preserve milled-equivalent rice and lint cotton; wheat products must match the WASDE wheat-equivalent scope.

ERS Oil Crops Yearbook XLSX or CSV using the normal download on the official catalogue; determine whether destination tables cover the complete soybean marketing year before replacing the calendar-year reference.

ERS Livestock and Meat International Trade Data annual CSVs: beef/veal, pork, chickens/turkeys/eggs; filter Annual 2025, not year-to-date. Include matching conversion-factor workbook. Keep other chicken distinct from broilers and hatching eggs distinct from food eggs. Obtain separate official dairy component-equivalent partner quantities; this ERS product excludes dairy.

FAOSTAT FO official CSV for USA and World, 2024, industrial roundwood (or total roundwood with the matching fuel scope), sawnwood and wood pulp: production/import quantity/export quantity, units, item and element codes, flags, notes and archive revision. Also export a same-definition partner matrix with World totals; stocks/actual domestic use require separate official balance inputs. Do not supply only integer country shares.
